findings.explanation: Co che dedup goc (tryMarkMid) la ben duy nhat dang tin cay: khoa theo (tenant_id, page_id, mid), ghi xuong Postgres/file adapter, khong TTL (chi gioi han so luong qua MID_LIMIT) nen song sot qua restart va nhieu instance. Nhung no chi chay khi 'mid' ton tai (dong 653: const mid = event.message?.mid;) - tuc CHI ap dung cho su kien co event.message (tin nhan van ban/anh). Su kien postback (nguoi dung bam nut menu/quick reply dang postback, khong co truong message) khong bao gio co mid, nen hoan toan bo qua lop dedup ben vung nay. Khi Facebook gui lai (retry) mot postback event vi khong nhan 200 kip thoi, request se roi thang xuong lop du phong yeu hon: shouldSkipDuplicateMessageText (dong 769) - la Map trong bo nho tien trinh (recentMessageTextKeys, dong 85), TTL chi 5 giay (MESSAGE_TEXT_DEDUPE_TTL_MS). Neu retry den sau 5s, hoac request thu hai roi vao tien trinh/instance khac (scale ngang, restart giua chung), khong co gi chan duoc xu ly + gui tin lap lan 2 - dung khop voi su co production da ghi nhan.

Duong gui menu tu dong cho referral-only event (khach bam quang cao/shortlink, khong kem message hay postback) khong di qua CA HAI lop dedup: khong co mid (bo qua tryMarkMid o dong 661) VA khong co userText (return som o nhanh !userText truoc khi cham toi shouldSkipDuplicateMessageText o dong 769). Bao ve duy nhat con lai la shouldSkipRecentMenuSend trong modes/menu-code-handoff.js (goi tu sendMenu, dong 178) - cung la Map bo nho tien trinh, TTL 15 giay (MENU_SEND_COOLDOWN_MS). Day la duong gui tin (gui menu) co it lop bao ve nhat trong toan bo webhook: khong ben vung, khong chia se giua cac instance, TTL ngan hon nhieu so voi cua so retry thuc te cua Facebook.
